metadata_prompt:
Extract metadata from the following academic paper text (from page {{page}}).
CRITICAL: Extract the FULL, COMPLETE title for the title field.
Also, generate a shortened "Ai" style title (Target length 10 words, Max length 12 words).
Format your response as a JSON object with keys: "year", "author" (last name only of first author), "venue" (short name), "title", "short_title".
Text: {{text}}
